# Xcode project generated by XcodeGen

The Xcode project is generated from a committed `project.yml` via XcodeGen; the `.xcodeproj` is git-ignored. Agents implement most tickets, and hand-editing `project.pbxproj` is error-prone and merge-hostile, while a short YAML file is easy to read and diff. Conversion logic lives in its own pure module with unit tests, separate from the SwiftUI app target. Requires `brew install xcodegen` once; run `xcodegen` after changing `project.yml` or adding files.
